text:
sophie_ops: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we keep getting intermittent paging storms for the auth proxy (mostly 403/401 bursts) due to a client-side retry loop + noisy downstream. Need clear owners, short-term suppressions, and a longer-term audit cadence. I sketched a remediation plan: docs: https://docs.internal/rems/auth-proxy-churn.

leo_oncall: I can own triage & short-term suppression logic. Proposal: implement a dedupe key based on (client_id + endpoint + short_hash(body)) and a rolling suppression window of 3m per key. That should stop repeat pages from the same offending client.

rachel_sre: I'll take threshold tuning + alert aggregation. Want to avoid hiding real regressions, so plan is phased: 1) change alert to aggregate by client_id for 10m windows, 2) add p99 spike detector for global signal. Also will add dashboards to measure alert reduction.

tom_dev: For dedupe key, prefer including request_path and first 48 bytes of body hash to avoid combining distinct users. I can add the hashing util and tests. How about a 2-stage rollout: staging -> canary (5% traffic) -> prod?

inc-bot: Incident 2026-01-09: auth-proxy 403 spike -> 38 pages, peak 04:12 UTC, impacted rotations: oncall-core.

zara_prod: For timeline, suggest short-term (<=2w) for suppression + dedupe, medium-term (3-6w) for thresholds+dashboards, long-term (8-12w) for audit automation + policy changes. I'll coordinate with customer success for clients that triggered noise.

leo_oncall: Draft alert expr for review (staging):
```
alert: AuthProxyHighAuthFailures
expr: sum(rate(proxy_auth_responses_total{status=~"4.."}[5m])) by (client_id, path) > 30
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: "/runbooks/auth-proxy-auth.md"
```
Paging dedupe config: key: "{{client_id}}:{{path}}:{{hash(body,6)}}" suppression_window: 3m

rachel_sre: Looks good. For rollout: can we gate by a synthetic that simulates retry loop behavior so we can validate suppression doesn't swallow real incidents? If so, I'll add the dashboard panels.

tom_dev: I will add the synthetic to the deploy pipeline and mock the retry loop. Tagging PR with "pm-followup/alert-tuning".

leo_oncall: Owners + ETAs: leo (dedupe + suppression) 1 days, rachel (thresholds + dashboards) 8 days, tom (hash util + synthetic) 2 days, zara (client outreach + audit policy) 4 days. Adding GH issues now.

zara_prod: I'll own the monthly churn audit job and the initial client list for outreach. Putting entries in the remediation tracker doc.

sophie_ops: Great. Sync scheduled Friday 09:30 UTC to review progress + open PR links. Please add the GH issue id to the tracker. If anyone needs quota for canary infra ping me.

leo_oncall: PR up for dedupe config in alertmanager, tests included. Marking as WIP.

tom_dev: Canary setup in CI is ready for a 5% rollout. Need approval to run on prod canary.

rachel_sre: Baseline metrics posted in tracker and dashboard links added. Will monitor after canary starts.

zara_prod: Contacted top 3 noisy clients, flagged behavioral fixes as recommendations.

sophie_ops: Thanks all. If the canary reduces pages by >70% over 48h we consider the short-term done and close those GH issues. Otherwise we reconvene and escalate. :thumbsup:
